services.desc: Step into a world of rejuvenation with our awe-inspiring performance saunas at Othership. Our saunas are designed to elevate your wellness experience, providing a clean, fresh heat that reaches up to 85°C (185°F). Infused with aromatic snowballs, our saunas offer not only intense heat but also a soothing and restorative humidity that will leave you feeling revitalized. Whether you're looking to unwind alone or share the experience with a friend, our saunas offer exactly what you need. Each session is designed to help you disconnect from the outside world and reconnect with yourself, offering a deeply restorative environment that promotes both physical and mental well-being.
